description: This Java source file is a configuration class for setting up the OpenAPI documentation in a Spring Boot project. It defines the overall API info, security, and tags used for organizing API endpoints, as well as external documentation links.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that creates and configures the OpenAPI bean for API documentation.

methods.name: openAPI
methods.description: Defines and returns a configured OpenAPI object with API info, tags, contact, license, and external documentation.
